what: OA-12 (MED, Tier-3 question). Sub-agent read of #15830 (restart-safe decision bars); I have not re-verified it. After a restart or stalled tick, every decision_bar: forming leg now re-runs its builder on the bar that closed during the gap. It can enter up to tf/16 after the close if price is within 0.25x the stop distance (src/runtime/intent_multiplexer.py ~532-629, ~733). This is an ENTRY-TIMING change on live Stage-1/2 legs, landed inside a Tier-2 restart fix with no backtest. It is guarded (ledger written first, journal same-bar refusal, price refusal fail-closed, debounce). Options: per-leg opt-in `decision_bar_catchup: true` (default off), or an explicit operator sign-off on the current behaviour.
